notes: Old kinds kept one-to-one (brush, ink stick, inkstone, set); two new kinds added (Calligraphy paper, Calligraphy desk accessories). Archetypes are regional types (Huzhou, Kumano, Nara brushes; Hui, Nara, Suzuka ink; Duan, She, Taohe, Chengni, Amehata, Akama, Ogatsu inkstones; xuan, hanji, hanshi papers). Old models kept: Kuretake Saiboku Shimbi as a coloured-stick version; Kuretake and Yasutomo suzuri in m. Restraint on sets: types only. Not added: Cao Sugong and other Qing ink masters (only search snippets); named Chinese brush houses beyond Huzhou; Korean inkstones (no page). Hu Kaiwen founding given as 1765 per Inkston (other sources say 1782). chiculture.org.hk blocked; makkura 404.
